csv_project_name: AE for N Campus Transportation Complex CDL Training Range
csv_agency: Mid Plains Community/N Platte Community College
csv_scope_of_work: Mid-Plains Community College is seeking qualified engineering services for the development of construction documents for a Commercial Driver Training Range at the North Campus Transportation Complex. A conceptual layout has been developed by the Owner. The selected engineer will refine, validate, and prepare complete construction documents for bidding and construction. Project Intent The project will develop a purpose-built CDL training range designed to support multiple simultaneous vehicle training maneuvers, including backing, docking, and maneuvering exercises. The design must ensure durability under repeated heavy truck loading, efficient traffic flow, and safe training operations.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
